speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Okay, we've got power to the laser.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I should've brought an umbrella.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: What for? It's not going to rain.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I know that, but with skin as fair as mine, moon burn is a real possibility.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: That's a bazinga, right?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: One of my best, don't you think?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Howard, do you want to double-check the equatorial mount on the laser? We need it locked onto the Sea of Tranquility.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: You got it. Oh, Raj, no. Billions of dollars have gone into inventing the Internet and filling it with pictures of naked women, so we don't have to peep through windows.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: It's not like that, I'm watching someone's TV. The Good Wife is on. I tell you, this is my new Grey's Anatomy.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Leonard, Leonard. What is that? What is that?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Relax, it's just a dirty sock.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: How on earth can you say dirty sock and relax in the same sentence?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Sheldon, the world is filled with dirty discarded socks.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Not my world.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Hey, you know who'd really dig seeing this experiment? Penny.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I wasn't aware that lunar ranging was her thing. Although, I suppose the retro-reflector left on the moon by Neil Armstrong does qualify as a shiny object.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Why don't you ask her to come up?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I don't know, it's still a little weird since, you know... She didn't dump me. We were just in different places in the relationship.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: She dumped you?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I fail to see how a relationship can have the qualities of a geographic location.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Oh, it's very simple. Leonard was living in a little town called please don't leave me, while Penny had just moved to the island of bye-bye.
